sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE original Amberweir Lockpike Warden walking passing pose matching this exact standing reference. Young woman short dark tousled hair, orange scarf/short cape, dark quilted armor brass shoulder/knee plates, black boots, belt keys/wax seals/brass cylinder. Keep RIGHT hand on full long black pike at screen LEFT, narrow two-prong gold fork head and pointed butt intact. LEFT forearm remains behind rectangular dark plank shield at screen RIGHT, brass bands/keyhole slot/red wax seal/ivory ribbon unchanged. Change legs: SHIELD-SIDE boot at screen RIGHT plants under pelvis, STANDARD/PIKE-SIDE leg at screen LEFT bends and lifts its boot behind the supporting shin, clear air gap under sole. A restrained walking passing step, not a high kick; shield stays close to torso and pike carried a few inches above ground. Both hands/arms and gear stay same screen sides, no mirror, no short spear, exactly two legs. Same elevated three-quarter RIGHT-facing camera and original painterly raster, figure proportions and entire pike preserved. Entire body, shield and BOTH pike tips in broad empty margins. Flat vivid GREEN #00ff00 through all empty gaps, neutral light no green spill on brass. No floor/shadow/text/effects/extra objects; ignore the tiny detached neighboring tip at bottom-left of reference.
sources.selection: Pike-side foot lifted, shield-side foot planted; use with matching new shield-side lift and original planted poses.

sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original Amberweir Lockpike Warden final corpse cutout. Close the woman's visible eyes fully, with relaxed lids and limp expression, no visible iris or stare. Preserve EXACT prone body pose, short dark hair, orange scarf/cape, armor, all limbs, grounded rectangular keyhole shield with wax seal/ribbon, and COMPLETE long fork-headed pike lying in front. No gore or added wounds. This is a persistent dead sprite, not a newly posed character. Remove only the tiny detached neighboring spear-tip fragment at bottom LEFT; keep the full owned pike from rear shaft to gold fork at bottom RIGHT. Keep same camera/proportions and full gear inside generous margins. Replace empty backing and enclosed gaps with flat vivid GREEN #00ff00, no green spill/reflections on art. Original painterly raster, no floor/shadow/text/effects/extra objects.
sources.selection: Visible eyes closed; full grounded shield/pike retained; neighboring detached spear tip removed.

sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Opposite-foot walking passing pose of this exact Amberweir Lockpike Warden. Raise the currently planted SHIELD-SIDE boot at screen RIGHT: bend knee modestly forward and lift foot near x560,y1450, clear green gap below boot; its knee may be partly behind shield but lower shin and boot visible below.
